title: "Experience & Education"

I'm currently a **Research Professional at the [IMAGINA Research Center](https://imagina.uniandes.edu.co/), Universidad de los Andes**, where I conduct applied research on **childhood, health, and violence prevention**, from study design and data-collection instruments to analysis and policy briefs for decision-makers.

## What I Do

- **Data cleaning, management, and analysis:** I write clean, well-documented code from scratch in R, Python, and Stata to clean, merge, and analyze large administrative and survey datasets, under Git version control.
- **Econometrics and impact evaluation:** I specify and interpret regression models, from descriptive analysis to causal inference, and have supported randomized evaluations from design to analysis.
- **Data collection design:** questionnaire design, instrument selection, and integration of SurveyCTO data into analysis pipelines.
- **Impact measurement systems:** theories of change, indicator frameworks with baselines and targets, and monitoring systems for social policies.
- **Dashboards and communication:** Power BI dashboards and interactive data tools, plus briefs and presentations for government, civil society, and research audiences.
- **AI for research:** Python pipelines with large language models to extract, classify, and summarize large volumes of documents.

## Experience

Built Python pipelines using **large language models** and text analysis to classify and summarize policy documents, identify overlaps across 719 service products, and develop **Power BI dashboards** to monitor 55 service lines.

Coded, cleaned, and harmonized **Violence Against Children and Youth Surveys (VACS)** data across 17 countries as part of the Colombian team for the CDC- and USAID-sponsored study.
